# TE Locus-Specific Analysis (M12)

## Locus-Level TE Differential Expression

> **M12 approach:** Custom pysam locus counter maps reads to individual RepeatMasker hg38 TE insertion coordinates (4.1M loci genome-wide). Loci with ≥10 total reads are tested with DESeq2 (**size factors from stable canonical genes**, same as Sections 3.4/3.5; `independentFiltering=FALSE`, LFC shrinkage: ashr). This is a **locus-resolution** complement to Section 3 (family-level pseudochromosome approach): here each row is a specific genomic TE insertion, not a family aggregate.

```{r m12-interaction-note, results='asis'}
if (is_interaction) {
  cat("::: {.callout-important}\n**Sezione non mostrata nel report Interaction** — M12 locus-level TE DE usa un modello ~condition proxy (mito-ChaRNA vs ChaRNA, 6 campioni). I risultati sono quasi identici al report mito-ChaRNA vs ChaRNA (differenze minime dovute a size factors leggermente diversi). Consulta quel report per l'analisi completa dei loci TE.\n:::\n")
}
```

```{r tet-results}
if (!is_interaction && !is.null(tet_sig) && nrow(tet_sig) > 0) {
  # Detect format: new (locus_id + te_name cols) vs legacy TEtranscripts
  is_new_fmt <- "locus_id" %in% colnames(tet_sig)

  if (is_new_fmt) {
    # Parse genomic coordinates from locus_id (format: family|class|sub_chrN_start_end_strand)
    # Extract the coordinate part starting at "chr"
    parse_coords <- function(lid) {
      m <- regmatches(lid, regexpr("(chr[^_]+)_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)_([+-])", lid, perl=TRUE))
      ifelse(nchar(m) > 0,
             sub("(chr[^_]+)_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)_([+-])", "\\1:\\2-\\3(\\4)", m),
             lid)
    }

    # Gene name lookup: find overlapping gene for each locus (top 200 only)
    genes_bed_path <- file.path(out, "mapping/annotation/genes_gtf.bed")
    m12_gene_map <- NULL
    if (file.exists(genes_bed_path)) {
      gbr <- read.table(genes_bed_path, header=FALSE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE,
                        col.names=c("chrom","start","end","gene_id","gene_name","gene_type"))
      # Build lookup function: for a set of loci, return overlapping gene names
      get_gene <- function(lids) {
        coords <- regmatches(lids, regexpr("(chr[^_]+)_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)_([+-])", lids, perl=TRUE))
        chr   <- sub("(chr[^_]+)_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)_([+-])", "\\1", coords)
        lstart <- as.integer(sub("(chr[^_]+)_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)_([+-])", "\\2", coords))
        lend   <- as.integer(sub("(chr[^_]+)_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)_([+-])", "\\3", coords))
        sapply(seq_along(lids), function(i) {
          if (is.na(lstart[i])) return(NA_character_)
          hits <- gbr[gbr$chrom == chr[i] &
                      gbr$start  <= lend[i] &
                      gbr$end    >= lstart[i], "gene_name", drop=TRUE]
          if (length(hits) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(unique(hits[!is.na(hits)]), collapse=";")
        })
      }
      m12_gene_map <- get_gene
    }

    te_features <- tet_sig |>
      mutate(
        Macro  = classify_macro(te_family),
        Coords = parse_coords(locus_id)
      ) |>
      arrange(padj) |>
      select(
        Coords,
        Family    = te_family,
        Class     = te_class,
        Macro,
        baseMean,
        `LFC (shrunk)` = log2FoldChange_shrunk,
        `LFC (raw)`    = log2FoldChange,
        pvalue, padj
      ) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
  } else {
    # Legacy TEtranscripts format
    tet_sig$feature_id <- if ("gene_id" %in% colnames(tet_sig)) tet_sig$gene_id else rownames(tet_sig)
    te_features <- tet_sig |>
      filter(!grepl("^ENSG", feature_id)) |>
      mutate(
        Family = sub(":.*", "", feature_id),
        Class  = sub("^[^:]+:[^:]+:(.*)", "\\1", feature_id),
        Macro  = classify_macro(Family)
      ) |>
      arrange(padj) |>
      select(Locus=feature_id, Family, Class, Macro,
             any_of(c("baseMean","log2FoldChange","log2FoldChange_shrunk","pvalue","padj"))) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
  }

  n_up <- sum(tet_sig$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm=TRUE)
  n_dn <- nrow(tet_sig) - n_up

  cat(sprintf("Significant TE loci (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f): **%d** (↑%d in %s, ↓%d in %s)\n",
              padj_thr, lfc_thr, nrow(tet_sig), n_up, p$treatment, n_dn, p$treatment))

  # Macrocategory summary table
  macro_sum <- te_features |>
    count(Macro, name="n_loci") |>
    arrange(desc(n_loci))
  knitr::kable(macro_sum, col.names=c("Macrocategory","Significant loci"),
               caption=sprintf("Significant TE loci by macrocategory (%s)", comp_label)) |>
    print()
} else if (!is_interaction) {
  cat("No significant TE loci found (padj<", padj_thr, ", |LFC|>", lfc_thr, ").\n")
}
```

```{r m12-volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Volcano plot — TE locus-level DESeq2 (M12). Each point = one RepeatMasker hg38 TE insertion locus. Red = upregulated in treatment, blue = downregulated. Top 20 most significant loci labelled by TE family name. LFC = shrunk (ashr)."}
if (!is_interaction && !is.null(tet_all) && nrow(tet_all) > 0) {
  lfc_col_m12 <- if ("log2FoldChange_shrunk" %in% colnames(tet_all)) "log2FoldChange_shrunk" else "log2FoldChange"
  vol_m12 <- tet_all |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(.data[[lfc_col_m12]])) |>
    mutate(
      lfc      = .data[[lfc_col_m12]],
      neglog10 = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
      sig      = padj < padj_thr & abs(lfc) > lfc_thr,
      col      = case_when(
        sig & lfc > 0 ~ paste0("UP in ", p$treatment),
        sig & lfc < 0 ~ paste0("DOWN in ", p$treatment),
        TRUE           ~ "NS"
      )
    )

  top_labels_m12 <- vol_m12 |>
    filter(sig) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    head(20) |>
    mutate(lbl = te_family)

  ggplot(vol_m12, aes(x=lfc, y=neglog10, color=col)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.3, size=0.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data=top_labels_m12,
                              aes(label=lbl), size=2.5, max.overlaps=20,
                              show.legend=FALSE, color="black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values=setNames(c("#E74C3C","#3498DB","#BDC3C7"),
                      c(paste0("UP in ",p$treatment),
                        paste0("DOWN in ",p$treatment),"NS")),
      name=NULL) +
    labs(title=sprintf("TE locus-level DE — %s (M12)", comp_label),
         subtitle=sprintf("%s loci tested | %d significant (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f)",
                          format(nrow(vol_m12), big.mark=","), sum(vol_m12$sig), padj_thr, lfc_thr),
         x="log2FC (shrunk, ashr)", y="-log10(padj)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
}
```

### Most-Affected Protein-Coding Genes

```{r m12-gene-ranking, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Top 25 protein-coding / lncRNA genes ranked by number of significant differentially expressed TE loci within their gene body. Each bar = one gene; colour indicates direction of the majority of loci (red = mostly UP in treatment, blue = mostly DOWN). Only genes with ≥1 overlapping RepeatMasker hg38 TE locus are counted. Genes are selected from GENCODE v49 (protein_coding + lncRNA only); RNA genes (Y_RNA, snRNA, snoRNA) are excluded."}
if (is_interaction) { invisible(NULL) } else {
gene_hits_path <- file.path(out, "m12", sprintf("%s_gene_hits.tsv", comp))
m12_gene_hits  <- if (file.exists(gene_hits_path))
  read.table(gene_hits_path, header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE) else NULL

if (!is.null(m12_gene_hits) && nrow(m12_gene_hits) > 0) {
  top_genes <- head(m12_gene_hits, 25) |>
    mutate(
      direction = ifelse(n_up >= n_dn, paste0("Mostly UP in ", p$treatment),
                                       paste0("Mostly DOWN in ", p$treatment)),
      gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels=rev(gene_name))
    )
  ggplot(top_genes, aes(x=gene_name, y=n_loci, fill=direction)) +
    geom_col(width=0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values=setNames(c("#E74C3C","#3498DB"),
                      c(paste0("Mostly UP in ",p$treatment),
                        paste0("Mostly DOWN in ",p$treatment))),
      name=NULL) +
    labs(title=sprintf("Top 25 protein-coding/lncRNA genes by DE TE loci — %s", comp_label),
         subtitle=sprintf("Total sig loci: %s | Genes with ≥1 locus: %d (protein_coding+lncRNA only)",
                          format(nrow(tet_sig), big.mark=","), nrow(m12_gene_hits)),
         x=NULL, y="Number of significant DE TE loci in gene body") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(legend.position="top")
} else {
  cat("Gene hit ranking not yet computed. Run M12 DESeq2 first.\n")
}
} # end !is_interaction
```

```{r m12-table}
if (!is_interaction && !is.null(tet_sig) && nrow(te_features) > 0) {
  disp_df <- te_features

  # Add gene name column for overlapping genes
  if (!is.null(m12_gene_map)) {
    raw_lids <- tet_sig$locus_id[order(tet_sig$padj)]

    disp_df <- disp_df |> select(Coords, Gene, everything())
  }

  DT::datatable(
    disp_df,
    caption=sprintf(
      "%d significant TE loci — M12 locus-level DESeq2 (%s vs %s, padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f). Each row = one RepeatMasker hg38 insertion. Gene: overlapping GENCODE v49 gene(s) at that locus (NA = intergenic). Use the table search/filter to explore; CSV/Excel export available.",
      nrow(te_features), p$treatment, p$control, padj_thr, lfc_thr),
    options=list(pageLength=20, scrollX=TRUE,
                 dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
    extensions="Buttons",
    rownames=FALSE
  )
} else if (!is_interaction && !is.null(tet_all) && nrow(tet_all) > 0) {
  # DESeq2 ran but no significant hits
  n_tested <- nrow(tet_all)
  cat(sprintf("M12 DESeq2 tested **%s** TE loci. No loci pass thresholds (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f) for this comparison.\n\n",
              format(n_tested, big.mark=","), padj_thr, lfc_thr))
  cat("This is expected when global TE expression changes are subtle at locus level: family-level results (Section 3) aggregate reads across all loci of the same family and have greater statistical power.\n")
} else if (!is_interaction) {
  cat("**M12 locus-level results not yet generated.**\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("Run: `Rscript scripts/m12_deseq2.R --locus-counts mosaic_output/m12/locus_counts.tsv --coldata coldata.tsv --outdir mosaic_output/m12 --treatment %s --control %s --comparison %s`\n",
              p$treatment, p$control, comp))
}

# De Novo Transcripts (M16 — StringTie)

> StringTie assembled transcripts de novo from STAR-aligned BAM files, then merged across samples and compared to GENCODE v49 using gffcompare. Novel transcripts were quantified with `-e -b` and tested for differential expression using DESeq2 (proxy counts from FPKM x 10).


## Assembly Summary

```{r st-summary}
if (!is.null(st_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(st_summary,
    caption="StringTie de novo assembly summary. 'Exact match' = transcripts fully matching GENCODE annotation. Novel categories: j=new junction combination, i=novel intronic, u=novel intergenic, x=antisense to reference.",
    col.names=c("Metric","Count"),
    format.args=list(big.mark=",")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("StringTie summary not available.
")
```

```{r st-class-codes, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Distribution of gffcompare class codes. Red = novel or partially novel transcripts; blue = matching reference annotation. 'j' (new junction combination) are high-confidence novel isoforms sharing splice sites with known transcripts."}
if (!is.null(st_class_codes)) {
  st_class_codes |>
    mutate(
      label = paste0(class_code, "
", sub(" .*","",description)),
      label = reorder(label, n)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=label, y=n, fill=novel)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#85C1E9"),
                      labels=c("TRUE"="Novel","FALSE"="Annotated"), name=NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
    labs(title="StringTie transcript classification (gffcompare)",
         x="Class code", y="Number of transcripts") +

} else cat("Class code data not available.
")

## Novel Transcript DE

```{r novel-de-summary}
if (!is.null(novel_de)) {
  n_sig <- sum(!is.na(novel_de$padj) & novel_de$padj < padj_thr &
                 abs(novel_de$log2FoldChange) > lfc_thr, na.rm=TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Novel transcripts tested: %d\n", nrow(novel_de)))
  cat(sprintf("Significant (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f): %d\n", padj_thr, lfc_thr, n_sig))
} else {
  # Explain based on StringTie assembly results
  if (!is.null(st_summary)) {
    novel_n <- tryCatch({
      novel_row <- st_summary[grepl("Novel candidates", st_summary[[1]], ignore.case=TRUE), ]
      if (nrow(novel_row) > 0) as.integer(novel_row[[2]][1]) else NA
    }, error=function(e) NA)
    if (!is.na(novel_n) && novel_n == 0) {
      cat("No novel transcripts to test: StringTie assembly found 0 novel transcript candidates.\n")
      cat("All assembled transcripts match GENCODE annotation exactly (class_code '=').\n")
      cat("This is the expected result when the reference annotation covers all detected isoforms.\n")
    } else {
      cat("Novel DE data not available (novel_transcript_DE.tsv not generated).\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Novel DE data not available (StringTie output or novel_transcript_DE.tsv missing).\n")
  }
}
```

```{r novel-de-volcano, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Volcano plot of novel transcript differential expression. Each point is a StringTie-assembled novel transcript not matching GENCODE annotation. Red = up-regulated in treatment; blue = down-regulated. Labels show transcript IDs of most significant events."}
if (!is.null(novel_de) && nrow(novel_de) > 0) {
  novel_de |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
    mutate(

      col = case_when(
        sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "UP",

        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      lab = ifelse(sig, t_name, NA)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj+1e-10), color=col)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=1.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=lab), size=2.5,
                              max.overlaps=15, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(UP="#E74C3C",DOWN="#3498DB",NS="#BDC3C7"),
                       name=NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    labs(title="Novel transcript DE - volcano",
         subtitle=comp_label,
         x=lfc_label,
         y="-log10(padj)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("Novel DE data not available.
")
```

# Differential Alternative Splicing (M17 — rMATS)

> rMATS quantified five classes of alternative splicing events from STAR-aligned BAM files: Skipped Exon (SE), Alternative 3'/5' Splice Site (A3SS/A5SS), Mutually Exclusive Exons (MXE), and Retained Intron (RI). deltaPSI = PSI(treatment) - PSI(control), where PSI (Percent Spliced In) ranges from 0 to 1.


## Event Summary

```{r splicing-summary, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Differential alternative splicing events by type. Positive bars = increased inclusion in treatment; negative bars = decreased inclusion (increased skipping/exclusion). deltaPSI threshold: 0.1."}
if (!is.null(splicing_summary)) {
  col_event <- c(SE="#E74C3C", A3SS="#3498DB", A5SS="#2ECC71",
                 MXE="#F39C12", RI="#9B59B6")
  label_event <- c(SE="Skipped Exon", A3SS="Alt 3' SS",
                   A5SS="Alt 5' SS", MXE="Mut. Excl.", RI="Ret. Intron")

  splicing_summary |>
    select(event_type, sig_enhanced, sig_skipped) |>
    pivot_longer(-event_type, names_to="direction", values_to="n") |>
    mutate(
      n = ifelse(direction=="sig_skipped", -n, n),
      direction = ifelse(direction=="sig_enhanced",
                         paste0("Increased in ", p$treatment),
                         paste0("Decreased in ", p$treatment))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=event_type, y=n, fill=direction)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#E74C3C","#3498DB"), name=NULL) +
    labs(title="Differential splicing events by type",
         subtitle=paste0(comp_label, " | |dPSI|>0.1"),
         x="Event type", y="Significant events") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13)
} else cat("Splicing summary not available.
")
```

```{r splicing-summary-table}
if (!is.null(splicing_summary)) {
  splicing_summary |>
    mutate(pct_sig=round(100*sig_events/total_events, 1)) |>
    select(Type=event_type, Description=description,
           Total=total_events, Significant=sig_events,
           `% sig`=pct_sig,
           `Increased`=sig_enhanced, `Decreased`=sig_skipped,
           `Mean |dPSI|`=mean_dpsi) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Summary of differential splicing events per type.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("Splicing summary not available.
")
```

} else cat("Hub gene plot not available.\n")

## WGCNA Co-expression Modules

```{r wgcna-modules}
if (!is.null(wgcna_modules) && nrow(wgcna_modules) > 0) {
  n_mods <- length(unique(wgcna_modules$module))
  cat(sprintf("WGCNA modules detected: %d
", n_mods))

  wgcna_modules |>
    group_by(module) |>
    summarise(n_genes=n(), top_hub=first(gene_name), .groups="drop") |>
    arrange(desc(n_genes)) |>
    DT::datatable(caption="WGCNA co-expression modules",
                  options=list(pageLength=15), rownames=FALSE)
} else {
  cat("WGCNA results not available — run M18 first.
")
}
```

```{r wgcna-module-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="WGCNA co-expression modules: genes per module. Grey = unassigned."}
if (!is.null(wgcna_modules) && nrow(wgcna_modules) > 0) {
  wgcna_modules |>
    group_by(module) |>
    summarise(n_genes=n(), .groups="drop") |>
    mutate(module=reorder(module, n_genes)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=module, y=n_genes, fill=module)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=n_genes), hjust=-0.1, size=3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(as.character(
      unique(wgcna_modules$module)),
      unique(wgcna_modules$module))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.15))) +
    labs(title="WGCNA modules", x="Module", y="Number of genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
} else cat("Module plot not available.\n")
```

```{r wgcna-trait-cor, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="WGCNA module-condition correlation. * = p<0.05. Positive = higher in treatment condition."}
if (!is.null(wgcna_mt_cor) && nrow(wgcna_mt_cor) > 0 &&
    !all(is.na(wgcna_mt_cor$correlation))) {
  p1 <- wgcna_mt_cor |>
    arrange(pvalue) |>
    mutate(sig=ifelse(!is.na(pvalue) & pvalue<0.05,"*",""),
           module=reorder(module, ifelse(is.na(correlation),0,correlation))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=module, y=correlation, fill=correlation>0)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(y=ifelse(correlation>0, correlation+0.05, correlation-0.05),
                  label=sig), size=5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth=0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#3498DB"), name=NULL,
                      labels=c("TRUE"=paste0("Higher in ",p$treatment),
                               "FALSE"=paste0("Higher in ",p$control))) +
    labs(title="Module-condition correlation",
         subtitle="* = p<0.05", x="Module", y="Pearson r") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
  print(p1)
  wgcna_mt_cor |>
    arrange(pvalue) |>
    mutate(sig=ifelse(pvalue<0.05,"*",""),
           across(c(correlation,pvalue), ~round(.,4))) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="WGCNA module-condition correlation table.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else if (!is.null(wgcna_mt_cor) && all(is.na(wgcna_mt_cor$correlation))) {
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    "> **Note — module-trait correlation not computable (n=3 per condition).**  \n",
    "> WGCNA identified %d co-expression modules (see hub genes above), but ",
    "Pearson module-eigengene/condition correlations require ≥6–10 samples per group ",
    "for reliable estimation. With n=3 per condition, all correlation values are NA. ",
    "This is a known limitation of WGCNA at low sample sizes; the modules themselves ",
    "are stable and the hub gene rankings are valid. Module-trait correlations will ",
    "be interpretable if the dataset is expanded.\n"),
    nrow(wgcna_mt_cor)))
} else cat("Module-trait correlation not available.\n")
```

## STRING PPI Network (M18)

> STRING v12.0 PPI network built from significant DE genes (padj<threshold, |LFC|>threshold). Edges = high-confidence protein interactions (combined score ≥400). Hub genes ranked by degree centrality. Communities detected with Louvain algorithm. Built by direct parsing of STRING flat files — no internet download required.

```{r string-ppi-status}
# Check data quality: real degrees (>0) vs empty run
string_ok <- !is.null(string_ppi_hubs) && nrow(string_ppi_hubs) > 0 &&
             "degree" %in% colnames(string_ppi_hubs) &&
             max(string_ppi_hubs$degree, na.rm=TRUE) > 0
edges_ok  <- !is.null(string_ppi_edges) && nrow(string_ppi_edges) > 0

if (!string_ok) {
  cat("STRING PPI results not available or all degrees = 0 (indicates a failed mapping run).\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("Re-run M18 to rebuild the network:\n```\npython -m mosaic run --modules m18_network --config config.yaml --comparison %s\n```\n", comp))
}
```

```{r string-ppi-network-img, fig.cap="STRING PPI network — largest connected component. Node size ∝ degree centrality (number of high-confidence interactions). Node colour = Louvain community. Top 30 hub genes labelled. Edge width ∝ combined interaction score."}
if (file.exists(string_network_png)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(string_network_png)
} else if (string_ok) {
  cat("Network PNG not found — will be generated on next M18 run.\n")
} else {
  cat("Network not available.\n")
}
```

```{r string-ppi-hubs}
if (string_ok) {
  string_ppi_hubs |>
    head(20) |>
    select(any_of(c("gene_name","degree","log2FC","padj"))) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.double), ~round(., 4))) |>
    DT::datatable(
      caption=sprintf(
        "Top 20 STRING PPI hub genes by degree centrality (%s, score ≥400). gene_name: HGNC symbol. degree: number of high-confidence interactions with other DE genes. log2FC/padj: from DESeq2.", comp_label),
      options=list(pageLength=20, dom="t"), rownames=FALSE)
}
```

```{r string-ppi-communities, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Louvain community sizes. Each community is a densely connected cluster of DE genes in the STRING network. Top genes (by degree) per community shown in parentheses."}
if (!is.null(string_ppi_comm) && nrow(string_ppi_comm) > 0 &&
    "module" %in% colnames(string_ppi_comm) &&
    max(string_ppi_comm$module, na.rm=TRUE) > 0) {
  # Top gene per community for annotation
  top_per_comm <- string_ppi_comm |>
    filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "NA") |>
    group_by(module) |>
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) |>
    slice_head(n=3) |>
    summarise(top_genes=paste(gene_name, collapse=", "), .groups="drop")
  comm_counts <- string_ppi_comm |>
    count(module, name="n_genes") |>
    left_join(top_per_comm, by="module") |>
    mutate(label=sprintf("C%d (%s)", module, top_genes),
           label=str_trunc(label, 45)) |>
    arrange(desc(n_genes))
  comm_counts |>
    mutate(label=factor(label, levels=rev(label))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=label, y=n_genes, fill=factor(module))) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=n_genes), hjust=-0.1, size=3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.2))) +
    labs(title="STRING PPI Louvain communities",
         subtitle="Top genes per community listed (ranked by |log2FC|)",
         x=NULL, y="Number of DE genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11)
} else cat("Community data not available or network has no edges.\n")
```

```{r string-ppi-network-table}
if (edges_ok) {
  string_ppi_edges |>
    select(any_of(c("gene1","gene2","combined_score"))) |>
    mutate(combined_score=round(combined_score, 0)) |>
    arrange(desc(combined_score)) |>
    head(100) |>
    DT::datatable(
      caption=sprintf("Top 100 STRING PPI interactions by combined score (%s). Both genes are significantly DE.", comp_label),
      filter="top",
      options=list(pageLength=20, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
} else cat("STRING PPI edge data not available — no interactions found between DE genes, or M18 has not been run yet.\n")
```

# RNA Editing (M19 — JACUSA2)

> RNA editing detected via JACUSA2 call-2 comparing BAM files between conditions. JACUSA2 detects all base-substitution mismatches at each site; M19 extracts and reports both **A-to-I (A→G)** editing (ADAR enzymes) and all other mismatch types including **C-to-U (C→T)** (APOBEC enzymes).


## Editing Summary

```{r editing-summary}
if (!is.null(editing_summary) && nrow(editing_summary) > 0) {
  editing_summary |>
    mutate(metric = gsub("_normal\\b", paste0("_", p$control),   metric),
           metric = gsub("_tumor\\b",  paste0("_", p$treatment), metric),
           metric = gsub("\\bnormal\\b", p$control,   metric),
           metric = gsub("\\btumor\\b",  p$treatment, metric)) |>
    knitr::kable(col.names=c("Metric","Value"),
      caption=sprintf("RNA A-to-I editing summary (JACUSA2). EF = editing frequency. dEF = EF(treatment) - EF(control). %s.", comp_label)) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("RNA editing summary not available.
")
```

## Differential Editing

```{r editing-scatter, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Editing frequency per site across conditions. Each point is an A-to-I editing site. Red = increased editing in treatment; blue = decreased; grey = similar. Points above diagonal = higher editing in treatment."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites) && nrow(editing_sites) > 0) {
  editing_sites |>
    mutate(col=case_when(
      dEF >  0.1 ~ paste0("Increased in ",p$treatment),
      dEF < -0.1 ~ paste0("Decreased in ",p$treatment),
      TRUE        ~ "Similar")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=EF1, y=EF2, color=col)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.6, size=1.5) +
    geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype="dashed",color="grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values=setNames(c("#E74C3C","#3498DB","#BDC3C7"),
                      c(paste0("Increased in ",p$treatment),
                        paste0("Decreased in ",p$treatment), "Similar")),
      name=NULL) +
    labs(title=sprintf("A-to-I editing frequency: %s vs %s", p$control, p$treatment),
         x=sprintf("EF (%s)", p$control),
         y=sprintf("EF (%s)", p$treatment)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13)
} else cat("Editing site data not available.
")
```

```{r editing-top-genes}
if (!is.null(editing_per_gene) && nrow(editing_per_gene) > 0) {
  # Rename hardcoded EF columns to use actual condition names
  epg <- editing_per_gene
  names(epg) <- gsub("\\bnormal\\b", p$control,   names(epg))
  names(epg) <- gsub("\\btumor\\b",  p$treatment, names(epg))

  # Filter: real gene names, score threshold (JACUSA2 DirMult:PHRED ≥ 1.5)
  epg_filt <- epg |>
    filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "-1",
           suppressWarnings(is.na(as.numeric(gene_name))),
           max_score >= 1.5) |>
    arrange(desc(max_score))

  if (nrow(epg_filt) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("No A-to-I editing genes with max_score ≥ 1.5 (%s).\n",
        comp_label))
  } else {
    epg_filt |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) |>
      DT::datatable(
        caption=sprintf(
        "Genes with A-to-I editing sites passing score threshold (%s). ",
        comp_label) |>
          paste0("n_sites: number of A-to-I (A→G) sites detected in the gene body. ",
                 "mean_EF_", p$control, "/mean_EF_", p$treatment,
                 ": mean editing frequency (edited reads / total reads) per condition. ",
                 "mean_dEF: mean difference in EF (treatment − control). ",
                 "max_score: maximum JACUSA2 DirMult:PHRED score across all sites in the gene — ",
                 "higher values indicate stronger statistical evidence for differential editing ",
                 "(threshold: 1.5, from config thresholds.min_score_editing)."),
        options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
  }
} else cat("Per-gene editing data not available.
")
```

```{r editing-alltype-table}
# Per-mismatch-type table for all substitutions (from editing_sites_all.tsv)
# Shows either per-gene (if gene_name present) or per-type summary with top sites
if (!is.null(editing_sites_all) && nrow(editing_sites_all) > 0 &&
    "mutation_type" %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) {

  has_gene <- "gene_name" %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)

  if (has_gene) {
    # Per-gene × type summary
    alltype_tbl <- editing_sites_all |>
      filter(!is.na(gene_name), gene_name != "-1",
             suppressWarnings(is.na(as.numeric(gene_name)))) |>
      group_by(gene_name, mutation_type) |>
      summarise(
        n_sites   = n(),
        mean_EF1  = round(mean(EF1, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
        mean_EF2  = round(mean(EF2, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
        mean_dEF  = round(mean(dEF, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
        max_score = round(max(score, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
        .groups="drop"
      ) |>
      filter(max_score >= 1.5) |>
      rename(!!paste0("mean_EF_", p$control)   := mean_EF1,
             !!paste0("mean_EF_", p$treatment) := mean_EF2) |>
      arrange(mutation_type, desc(max_score))
    cap_extra <- "gene_name: host gene. "
  } else {
    # No gene_name: top sites per type filtered by score
    alltype_tbl <- editing_sites_all |>
      filter(score >= 1.5) |>
      select(chrom, start, end, strand, mutation_type, score,
             EF1, EF2, dEF, cov1, cov2) |>
      rename(!!paste0("EF_", p$control)   := EF1,
             !!paste0("EF_", p$treatment) := EF2,
             cov_ctrl := cov1, cov_treat := cov2) |>
      arrange(mutation_type, desc(score))
    cap_extra <- "chrom/start/end/strand: genomic position. "
  }

  if (nrow(alltype_tbl) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("No editing sites with score ≥ 1.5 for any mismatch type (%s).\n",
        comp_label))
  } else {
    alltype_tbl |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) |>
      DT::datatable(
        caption=sprintf(
        "All mismatch types — editing sites with score ≥ 1.5 (%s). ",
        comp_label) |>
          paste0(cap_extra,
                 "mutation_type: base substitution on + strand ",
                 "(T>C and G>A are the antisense strand reads for A>G and C>T, respectively). ",
                 "score: JACUSA2 DirMult:PHRED score — statistical evidence for differential editing ",
                 "(≥1.5 used as quality filter; higher = more reliable). ",
                 "EF_", p$control, "/EF_", p$treatment,
                 ": editing frequency (edited reads / total reads) per condition. ",
                 "dEF: EF(", p$treatment, ") − EF(", p$control, "). ",
                 "cov: read coverage per condition."),
        filter="top",
        options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
  }
} else {
  cat("All-type editing data not available (editing_sites_all.tsv not found or empty).\n")
}
```

## All Mismatch Types (M19 — JACUSA2)

> All base-substitution mismatches detected by JACUSA2 (A→G, C→T, A→C, A→T, C→A, C→G, G→A, G→C, G→T, T→A, T→C, T→G). Filtered for sites supported by ≥3 reads and >5% mismatch frequency per condition.

```{r editing-all-types, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Mean editing frequency (EF) per mismatch type, split by condition (control = EF1, treatment = EF2). Error bars = SEM across sites. Wilcoxon p-value shown for each type (treatment vs control EF per site). Red = ADAR canonical (A→G); blue = APOBEC canonical (C→T); grey = other types. Only types with ≥10 supporting sites are shown."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites_all) && nrow(editing_sites_all) > 0) {
  mut_col <- if ("mutation_type" %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) "mutation_type" else
             if ("edit_type"     %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) "edit_type" else NULL
  if (!is.null(mut_col) && all(c("EF1","EF2") %in% colnames(editing_sites_all))) {
    canonical_adar   <- c("AG","A>G","TC","T>C")
    canonical_apobec <- c("CT","C>T","GA","G>A")

    type_ef <- editing_sites_all |>
      group_by(.data[[mut_col]]) |>
      summarise(
        n_sites  = n(),
        mean_EF1 = mean(EF1, na.rm=TRUE),
        sem_EF1  = sd(EF1, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(EF1))),
        mean_EF2 = mean(EF2, na.rm=TRUE),
        sem_EF2  = sd(EF2, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(EF2))),
        wilcox_p = tryCatch(
          wilcox.test(EF2, EF1, paired=FALSE, exact=FALSE)$p.value,
          error=function(e) NA_real_),
        .groups="drop"
      ) |>
      filter(n_sites >= 10) |>
      mutate(
        edit_class = case_when(
          .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_adar   ~ "ADAR (A→G)",
          .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_apobec ~ "APOBEC (C→T)",
          TRUE                                   ~ "other"
        ),
        sig_mark = case_when(
          is.na(wilcox_p)  ~ "",
          wilcox_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
          wilcox_p < 0.01  ~ "**",
          wilcox_p < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE              ~ ""
        ),
        p_label = ifelse(!is.na(wilcox_p), sprintf("p=%.3f", wilcox_p), "")
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(mean_EF2 + mean_EF1))

    # Pivot to long format for grouped bars
    ef_long <- type_ef |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_EF1, mean_EF2),
                          names_to="cond_key", values_to="mean_EF") |>
      mutate(
        condition = ifelse(cond_key == "mean_EF1", p$control, p$treatment),
        sem       = ifelse(cond_key == "mean_EF1", sem_EF1, sem_EF2)
      )

    # y position for p labels (above the taller bar)
    p_pos <- type_ef |>
      mutate(y_pos = pmax(mean_EF1, mean_EF2) + pmax(sem_EF1, sem_EF2) + 0.005)

    col_class <- c("ADAR (A→G)"="#E74C3C", "APOBEC (C→T)"="#3498DB", "other"="#BDC3C7")

    ggplot(ef_long,
           aes(x=reorder(.data[[mut_col]], mean_EF + mean_EF),
               y=mean_EF, fill=edit_class, alpha=condition)) +
      geom_col(position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.7) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(mean_EF-sem,0), ymax=mean_EF+sem),
                    position=position_dodge(0.8), width=0.3, linewidth=0.5,
                    show.legend=FALSE) +
      # Show p-value only if significant
      geom_text(data=p_pos |> filter(nzchar(sig_mark)),
                aes(x=.data[[mut_col]], y=y_pos, label=sig_mark, fill=NULL, alpha=NULL),
                size=4.5, fontface="bold", color="#C0392B", inherit.aes=FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_class, name="Editing class") +
      scale_alpha_manual(values=setNames(c(0.55, 1.0), c(p$control, p$treatment)),
                         name="Condition") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title=sprintf("RNA mismatch types: mean EF per condition (%s)",
        comp_label),
           subtitle="Bars = mean EF ± SEM across sites. * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001 (Wilcoxon, site-level)",
           x="Mismatch type", y="Mean editing frequency") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=12)
  } else {
    cat("Column 'mutation_type'/'edit_type' or EF1/EF2 not found in editing_sites_all.tsv.\n")
    cat(sprintf("Available columns: %s\n", paste(colnames(editing_sites_all), collapse=", ")))
  }
} else {
  cat("All-type editing data not available (editing_sites_all.tsv not generated by M19).\n")
  cat("Re-run M19 to extract all mismatch types from the JACUSA2 output.\n")
}
```

### Differential Editing Activity per Mismatch Type

> For each mismatch type, editing frequency per site is compared between conditions using a Wilcoxon rank-sum test (sites present in both conditions). A>G (ADAR) and C>T (APOBEC) are the canonical RNA editing types. Asymmetry in other types (e.g. G>A, T>C) can reflect DNA damage signatures or sequencing artefacts and should be interpreted with caution.

```{r editing-diff-by-type, fig.height=6, fig.width=11, fig.cap="Per-mismatch-type comparison of editing frequency between conditions. Left: mean EF per condition (only types with ≥10 sites); right: Wilcoxon p-value and log2FC of EF. Red = ADAR canonical (A>G/T>C), blue = APOBEC canonical (C>T/G>A), grey = other."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites_all) && nrow(editing_sites_all) > 0 &&
    "mutation_type" %in% colnames(editing_sites_all)) {
  mut_col <- "mutation_type"
  canonical_adar  <- c("A>G","T>C")
  canonical_apobec <- c("C>T","G>A")

  type_stats <- editing_sites_all |>
    group_by(.data[[mut_col]]) |>
    summarise(
      n_sites    = n(),
      mean_EF1   = mean(EF1, na.rm=TRUE),
      mean_EF2   = mean(EF2, na.rm=TRUE),
      median_EF1 = median(EF1, na.rm=TRUE),
      median_EF2 = median(EF2, na.rm=TRUE),
      wilcox_p   = tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(EF2, EF1, paired=FALSE, exact=FALSE)$p.value,
        error=function(e) NA_real_),
      .groups="drop"
    ) |>
    filter(n_sites >= 10) |>
    mutate(
      log2FC_EF  = log2((mean_EF2 + 1e-4) / (mean_EF1 + 1e-4)),
      padj       = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method="BH"),
      sig        = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05,
      edit_class = case_when(
        .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_adar   ~ "ADAR (A-to-I)",
        .data[[mut_col]] %in% canonical_apobec ~ "APOBEC (C-to-U)",
        TRUE                                   ~ "other"
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(wilcox_p)

  col_class <- c("ADAR (A-to-I)"="#E74C3C",
                 "APOBEC (C-to-U)"="#3498DB",
                 "other"="#BDC3C7")

  # Left: mean EF per condition
  ef_long <- type_stats |>
    select(.data[[mut_col]], mean_EF1, mean_EF2, edit_class, n_sites) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_EF1, mean_EF2),
                        names_to="condition", values_to="mean_EF") |>
    mutate(condition=ifelse(condition=="mean_EF1", p$control, p$treatment))

  p_ef <- ggplot(ef_long,
                 aes(x=reorder(.data[[mut_col]], mean_EF),
                     y=mean_EF, fill=edit_class, alpha=condition)) +
    geom_col(position="dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_class, name="Editing class") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values=setNames(c(0.6,1.0), c(p$control, p$treatment)),
                       name="Condition") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title="Mean EF per mismatch type",
         x=NULL, y="Mean editing frequency") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11)

  # Right: log2FC EF vs -log10(p)
  p_vol <- ggplot(type_stats,
                  aes(x=log2FC_EF, y=-log10(pmax(wilcox_p, 1e-10)),
                      color=edit_class, label=.data[[mut_col]], size=n_sites)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3, max.overlaps=20) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey70") +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_class, name="Editing class") +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(3,9), name="N sites") +
    labs(title=sprintf("EF change: %s", comp_label),
         x=paste0("log2FC mean EF (", comp_label, ")"),
         y="-log10(Wilcoxon p)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11)

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_ef, p_vol, ncol=2)
  # Save type_stats for table chunk below
  .type_stats_df <- type_stats
  .mut_col_saved <- mut_col
} else {
  cat("All-type editing data not available for differential analysis.\n")
  .type_stats_df <- NULL
  .mut_col_saved <- NULL
}
```

```{r editing-diff-by-type-table, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Table in separate chunk (results='asis') to avoid raw HTML leaking into plots
if (!is.null(.type_stats_df) && nrow(.type_stats_df) > 0) {
  cat("\n**Differential editing by type (BH-corrected):**\n\n")
  .type_stats_df |>
    mutate(across(c(mean_EF1, mean_EF2, log2FC_EF), ~round(., 4)),
           wilcox_p=round(wilcox_p, 4), padj=round(padj, 4)) |>
    select(.data[[.mut_col_saved]], n_sites, mean_EF1, mean_EF2,
           log2FC_EF, wilcox_p, padj, edit_class) |>
    dplyr::rename(mutation_type=1,
                  !!paste0("mean_EF_", p$control)  := mean_EF1,
                  !!paste0("mean_EF_", p$treatment) := mean_EF2) |>
    knitr::kable(caption="Differential editing frequency by mismatch type. BH-corrected p-value. Types with padj<0.05 are statistically significant.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
}
```

### ADAR Editing Sites in TE Loci (Alu/IR-Alu)

> Inverted Alu repeats (IR-Alu) form double-stranded RNA hairpin structures that are the primary substrate for ADAR1/2-mediated A-to-I editing. In chromatin-associated RNA, edited dsRNA regions within Alu elements reflect changes in TE transcriptional activity and local chromatin structure. Mitotic chromatin compaction is expected to alter accessibility of IR-Alu pairs, potentially changing editing efficiency.

```{r adar-te-overlap, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="ADAR editing sites (A>G) overlapping TE loci from RepeatMasker hg38. Left: proportion of editing sites in each TE macrocategory vs intergenic/non-TE. Right: for sites in Alu elements, editing frequency comparison between conditions."}
if (!is.null(editing_sites) && nrow(editing_sites) > 0 &&
    !is.null(rmsk_bed) && nrow(rmsk_bed) > 0 && .gr_available) {

  GR  <- GenomicRanges::GRanges
  IR  <- IRanges::IRanges

  # Build GRanges for editing sites
  ed_gr <- GR(
    seqnames = editing_sites$chrom,
    ranges   = IR(start=editing_sites$start + 1, end=editing_sites$end),
    strand   = if ("strand" %in% colnames(editing_sites))
                 editing_sites$strand else "*"
  )
  GenomicRanges::mcols(ed_gr) <- editing_sites[, intersect(c("EF1","EF2","dEF","score"),
                                                             colnames(editing_sites))]

  # Build GRanges for rmsk (parse TE name = first part before |)
  rmsk_bed$te_name <- sub("\\|.*","", rmsk_bed$name)
  rmsk_gr <- GR(
    seqnames = rmsk_bed$chrom,
    ranges   = IR(start=rmsk_bed$start + 1, end=rmsk_bed$end),
    strand   = rmsk_bed$strand
  )
  GenomicRanges::mcols(rmsk_gr)$te_name <- rmsk_bed$te_name

  # Find overlaps
  hits    <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(ed_gr, rmsk_gr, ignore.strand=TRUE)
  n_total <- length(ed_gr)

  if (length(hits) > 0) {
    ed_idx   <- S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)   # nolint
    rmsk_idx <- S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits) # nolint
    te_names <- GenomicRanges::mcols(rmsk_gr)$te_name[rmsk_idx]
    te_macro <- classify_macro(te_names)

    # Keep first hit per editing site (nearest/first TE)
    ov_df <- data.frame(
      ed_idx=ed_idx, te_name=te_names, te_macro=te_macro
    ) |> dplyr::distinct(ed_idx, .keep_all=TRUE)

    n_in_te <- length(unique(ov_df$ed_idx))
    n_not_te <- n_total - n_in_te

    # Pie / bar: distribution by TE macro
    macro_cnt <- ov_df |>
      count(te_macro, name="n") |>
      add_row(te_macro="non-TE / intergenic", n=n_not_te) |>
      mutate(pct=round(100*n/n_total,1))

    p_bar <- ggplot(macro_cnt,
                    aes(x=reorder(te_macro, n), y=n,
                        fill=ifelse(te_macro=="non-TE / intergenic","grey",te_macro))) +
      geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)",n,pct)),
                hjust=-0.05, size=3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c(col_macro,
                                  "non-TE / intergenic"="#BDC3C7",
                                  "grey"="#BDC3C7")) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.3))) +
      labs(title=sprintf("ADAR A>G sites in TE context (%d/%d, %.1f%%)",
                         n_in_te, n_total, 100*n_in_te/n_total),
           x=NULL, y="Number of editing sites") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11)

    # Right: Alu sites — EF per condition
    alu_idx <- ov_df$ed_idx[grepl("^Alu|^MIR", ov_df$te_name, ignore.case=TRUE)]
    if (length(alu_idx) >= 5) {
      alu_sites <- editing_sites[alu_idx, ] |>
        tidyr::pivot_longer(c(EF1, EF2), names_to="condition", values_to="EF") |>
        mutate(condition=ifelse(condition=="EF1", p$control, p$treatment))

      p_alu <- ggplot(alu_sites, aes(x=condition, y=EF, fill=condition)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.8, alpha=0.8) +
        geom_jitter(width=0.1, size=0.6, alpha=0.4) +
        scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(c("#85C1E9","#E74C3C"),
                                          c(p$control, p$treatment)),
                          guide="none") +
        labs(title=sprintf("EF at Alu editing sites (%d sites)", length(alu_idx)),
             subtitle=sprintf("Wilcoxon p=%.4f",
               tryCatch(wilcox.test(
                 editing_sites$EF2[alu_idx],
                 editing_sites$EF1[alu_idx], paired=TRUE, exact=FALSE)$p.value,
                 error=function(e) NA_real_)),
             x=NULL, y="Editing frequency") +
        theme_minimal(base_size=11)

      gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_bar, p_alu, ncol=2)
    } else {
      print(p_bar)
    }
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("No overlap between %d A>G editing sites and rmsk_hg38.bed.\n", n_total))
    cat("Check chromosome name compatibility (chr1 vs 1).\n")
  }
} else {
  if (!.gr_available) cat("GenomicRanges not available — install Bioconductor GenomicRanges.\n")
  else if (is.null(rmsk_bed)) cat("rmsk_hg38.bed not loaded (run M11 first).\n")
  else if (is.null(editing_sites) || nrow(editing_sites)==0)
    cat("A-to-I editing sites not available.\n")
}
```

> Reads not mapping to the human reference genome (STAR unmapped) were classified taxonomically using Kraken2 v2.1.3 with the k2_minusb database. Bracken estimated species-level abundances. Homo sapiens reads excluded from microbial analysis.


## Classification Summary

```{r meta-classification}
if (!.m20_enabled) { invisible(NULL) } else
if (!is.null(meta_summary)) {
  meta_summary |>
    filter(if (is_interaction) TRUE else condition %in% c(p$treatment, p$control)) |>
    mutate(pct_classified=paste0(pct_classified,"%")) |>
    select(Sample=sample_id, Condition=condition,
           `Total reads`=total_reads,
           `Classified`=classified,
           `% classified`=pct_classified) |>
    knitr::kable(caption=sprintf("Kraken2 classification rates for unmapped reads — %s.", comp_label)) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Kraken2 classification summary not available (kraken2_classification_summary.tsv missing).\n\n")
  # Fall back to showing per-sample microbial read counts from abundance matrix
  if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
    meta_col3 <- if (!is.null(coldata) && nrow(coldata)>0) coldata else coldata_all
    sids_meta <- meta_col3$sample_id[meta_col3$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
    if (length(sids_meta) > 0) {
      micro_totals <- colSums(meta_abund[, sids_meta, drop=FALSE])
      cond_map_m <- setNames(meta_col3$condition, meta_col3$sample_id)
      micro_tbl <- data.frame(
        Sample    = sids_meta,
        Condition = cond_map_m[sids_meta],
        `Microbial reads (Bracken, excl. Homo sapiens)` = as.integer(micro_totals[sids_meta]),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
      knitr::kable(micro_tbl,
        caption=sprintf("Microbial read counts from Bracken (Homo sapiens excluded). These are unmapped reads classified to non-human taxa. The fraction relative to total input reads indicates overall microbial load. Visible in Section 1.4 RNA landscape as 'Microbial' bar. %s.", comp_label)) |>
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
    }
  }
}
```

## Microbial Composition

```{r meta-barplot, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Relative abundance of microbial species in unmapped reads per sample (Homo sapiens excluded). With full data, microbial signatures (viruses, bacteria, fungi) may be detected here."}
if (!.m20_enabled) invisible(NULL) else
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  # Use comparison coldata (filtered to 2 conditions)
  meta_coldata <- if (!is.null(coldata) && nrow(coldata)>0) coldata else coldata_all
  if (is.null(meta_coldata)) {
    cat("Coldata not available — cannot plot microbial abundance.\n")
  } else {
  sample_cols <- meta_coldata$sample_id[meta_coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  if (length(sample_cols) == 0) {
    cat("No matching samples between coldata and microbial abundance matrix.\n")
  } else {
  rel_df <- meta_abund |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
                        names_to="sample_id", values_to="reads") |>
    left_join(meta_coldata[,c("sample_id","condition")], by="sample_id") |>
    group_by(sample_id, condition) |>
    mutate(rel_abund=reads/sum(reads)*100) |>
    ungroup()

  top_taxa <- rel_df |>
    group_by(name) |>
    summarise(m=mean(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    arrange(desc(m)) |> head(12) |> pull(name)

  rel_df |>
    mutate(taxon=ifelse(name %in% top_taxa, name, "Other")) |>
    group_by(sample_id, condition, taxon) |>
    summarise(rel_abund=sum(rel_abund),.groups="drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x=sample_id, y=rel_abund, fill=taxon)) +
    geom_col(position="stack") +
    facet_wrap(~condition, scales="free_x") +
    labs(title="Microbial composition (unmapped reads)",
         x=NULL, y="Relative abundance (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1),
          legend.text=element_text(size=8))
  }} # close sample_cols and meta_coldata checks
} else cat("Microbial abundance data not available.
")
```

```{r meta-beta-pca, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
if (!.m20_enabled) invisible(NULL) else
if (!is.null(meta_abund) && nrow(meta_abund) > 0) {
  sample_cols_b <- coldata$sample_id[coldata$sample_id %in% colnames(meta_abund)]
  if (length(sample_cols_b) >= 3) {
    mat_b <- as.matrix(meta_abund[, sample_cols_b])
    # Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
    bc_dist <- if (requireNamespace("vegan", quietly=TRUE)) {
      as.matrix(vegan::vegdist(t(mat_b), method="bray"))
    } else {
      # Manual Bray-Curtis
      n <- ncol(mat_b)
      d <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames=list(sample_cols_b, sample_cols_b))
      for (i in 1:n) for (j in 1:n) {
        d[i,j] <- sum(abs(mat_b[,i]-mat_b[,j])) / sum(mat_b[,i]+mat_b[,j]+1e-10)
      }
      d
    }
    # PCoA
    pcoa <- cmdscale(bc_dist, k=2, eig=TRUE)
    var_exp <- round(pcoa$eig[1:2]/sum(abs(pcoa$eig))*100, 1)
    pcoa_df <- data.frame(
      sample_id=rownames(pcoa$points),
      PC1=pcoa$points[,1], PC2=pcoa$points[,2]
    ) |> mutate(condition=conditions[sample_id])

    p_pcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2,
                                   color=condition, label=sample_id)) +
      geom_point(size=5, alpha=0.9) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3, show.legend=FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values=col_cond, name=NULL) +
      labs(title="PCoA - Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
           x=paste0("PC1 (",var_exp[1],"%)"),
           y=paste0("PC2 (",var_exp[2],"%)")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=12)

    p_heat <- bc_dist |> as.data.frame() |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("s1") |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-s1, names_to="s2", values_to="dist") |>
      ggplot(aes(x=s1, y=s2, fill=dist)) +
      geom_tile() +
      geom_text(aes(label=round(dist,2)), size=3) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="#E74C3C", name="BC dist") +
      labs(title="Bray-Curtis distance matrix", x=NULL, y=NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1))

    # fig title (since fig.cap moved here dynamically)
    cat(sprintf("\n*Beta diversity: Bray-Curtis PCoA (left) and distance matrix (right). %s.*\n", comp_label))
    gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_pcoa, p_heat, ncol=2)
  } else {
    cat("Need >= 3 samples for beta diversity analysis.\n")
  }
} else cat("Microbial abundance data not available.\n")
```

## Functional Profiling (M20b — HUMAnN3)

> HUMAnN3 profiles the functional capacity of microbial communities by mapping STAR-unmapped reads to the ChocoPhlAn nucleotide database and UniRef90 protein database. Outputs: gene family abundances (UniRef90 RPK), MetaCyc pathway abundances and coverage.
>
> MetaCyc pathway abundances (CPM) filtered to the current comparison samples. **mean_treat / mean_ctrl**: mean CPM across replicates. **log2FC**: log2(mean_treat / mean_ctrl). **enriched_in**: |log2FC|>1 direction. No statistical test is applied to pathway abundances (HUMAnN3 does not output p-values); treat log2FC as exploratory.

```{r humann-pathways}
if (!.m20_enabled) invisible(NULL) else
if (!is.null(humann_paths) && nrow(humann_paths) > 0) {
  df <- humann_paths
  colnames(df) <- sub("_Unmapped[.]out_Abundance.*", "", colnames(df))
  colnames(df)[1] <- "Pathway"
  df <- df[, !duplicated(colnames(df))]

  # Filter: keep only pathway-level rows (no "|" stratification, no UNMAPPED/UNINTEGRATED)
  df_clean <- df |>
    filter(!grepl("UNMAPPED|UNINTEGRATED", Pathway),
           !grepl("|", Pathway, fixed=TRUE))

  # Filter columns to comparison samples
  treat_sids_p   <- if (!is.null(coldata)) coldata$sample_id[coldata$condition == p$treatment] else character(0)
  control_sids_p <- if (!is.null(coldata)) coldata$sample_id[coldata$condition == p$control]   else character(0)
  treat_cols_p   <- intersect(treat_sids_p,   colnames(df_clean))
  control_cols_p <- intersect(control_sids_p, colnames(df_clean))

  if (length(treat_cols_p) > 0 || length(control_cols_p) > 0) {
    df_clean <- df_clean |>
      select(Pathway, all_of(c(treat_cols_p, control_cols_p)))
  }

  # Add summary stats
  if (length(treat_cols_p) > 0 && length(control_cols_p) > 0) {
    df_clean <- df_clean |>
      mutate(
        mean_treat = rowMeans(across(all_of(treat_cols_p)),   na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_ctrl  = rowMeans(across(all_of(control_cols_p)), na.rm=TRUE),
        log2FC     = round(log2((mean_treat + 0.01) / (mean_ctrl + 0.01)), 2),
        enriched_in = case_when(
          log2FC >  1 ~ paste0("\u2191 ", p$treatment),
          log2FC < -1 ~ paste0("\u2193 ", p$control),
          TRUE        ~ "similar"
        )
      ) |>
      mutate(mean_treat=round(mean_treat,2), mean_ctrl=round(mean_ctrl,2))
    names(df_clean)[names(df_clean)=="mean_treat"] <- sprintf("mean_%s", p$treatment)
    names(df_clean)[names(df_clean)=="mean_ctrl"]  <- sprintf("mean_%s", p$control)
    # Sort by treatment mean, show top 50
    df_show <- df_clean |>
      arrange(desc(.data[[sprintf("mean_%s", p$treatment)]])) |>
      head(50)
  } else {
    df_show <- df_clean |>
      mutate(mean_all=rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) |>
      arrange(desc(mean_all)) |>
      head(50)
  }

  if (nrow(df_show) > 0 && max(df_show[,2], na.rm=TRUE) > 0) {
    DT::datatable(df_show,
      caption=sprintf("Top 50 MetaCyc pathways (HUMAnN3 CPM) — %s. Filtered to comparison samples only. log2FC = exploratory (no p-value from HUMAnN3).", comp_label),
      filter="top",
      options=list(pageLength=20, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No pathway abundance detected above zero.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("HUMAnN3 MetaCyc pathway data not available. Run: humann_join_tables + humann_renorm_table on per-sample *_pathabundance.tsv files.\n")
}
```

```{r humann-genes}
if (!.m20_enabled) invisible(NULL) else
if (!is.null(humann_genes) && nrow(humann_genes) > 0) {
  df_g <- humann_genes
  # Fix column names: strip HUMAnN3 suffix, keep sample IDs
  colnames(df_g) <- sub("_Unmapped[.]out_Abundance.*", "", colnames(df_g))
  colnames(df_g)[1] <- "UniRef90_ID"
  df_g <- df_g[, !duplicated(colnames(df_g))]

  # Filter: remove UNMAPPED and stratified rows (contain "|")
  df_g_clean <- df_g |>
    filter(!grepl("UNMAPPED|UNINTEGRATED", UniRef90_ID),
           !grepl("|", UniRef90_ID, fixed=TRUE))

  # Filter columns to comparison samples only (+ ID column)
  treat_sids_h  <- if (!is.null(coldata)) coldata$sample_id[coldata$condition == p$treatment] else character(0)
  control_sids_h <- if (!is.null(coldata)) coldata$sample_id[coldata$condition == p$control] else character(0)
  comp_sids_h   <- c(treat_sids_h, control_sids_h)
  comp_cols_h   <- intersect(comp_sids_h, colnames(df_g_clean))

  if (length(comp_cols_h) > 0) {
    df_g_clean <- df_g_clean |> select(UniRef90_ID, all_of(comp_cols_h))
  }

  # Add mean per condition and fold change if we have both groups
  if (length(treat_sids_h) > 0 && length(control_sids_h) > 0) {
    treat_cols_h   <- intersect(treat_sids_h, colnames(df_g_clean))
    control_cols_h <- intersect(control_sids_h, colnames(df_g_clean))
    df_g_clean <- df_g_clean |>
      mutate(
        mean_treat  = rowMeans(across(all_of(treat_cols_h)),  na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_ctrl   = rowMeans(across(all_of(control_cols_h)), na.rm=TRUE),
        log2FC      = round(log2((mean_treat + 0.01) / (mean_ctrl + 0.01)), 2),
        enriched_in = case_when(
          log2FC >  1 ~ paste0("↑ ", p$treatment),
          log2FC < -1 ~ paste0("↓ ", p$control),
          TRUE        ~ "similar"
        )
      )
  } else {
    df_g_clean <- df_g_clean |>
      mutate(mean_treat=rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE),
             mean_ctrl=NA_real_, log2FC=NA_real_, enriched_in="—")
  }

  df_g_top <- df_g_clean |>
    arrange(desc(mean_treat)) |>
    head(50) |>
    mutate(
      # UniRef90_GENENAME_TAXID or UniRef90_UNIPROT — extract gene symbol if present
      Gene_Name = sub("^UniRef90_", "", UniRef90_ID),
      # If it looks like a UniProt accession (all caps, alphanumeric, 6-10 chars), label as UniProt
      Gene_Name = ifelse(grepl("^[A-Z][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3,8}$", Gene_Name),
                         paste0("(UniProt:", Gene_Name, ")"),
                         sub("_[A-Z0-9]+$", "", Gene_Name))
    ) |>
    mutate(mean_treat = round(mean_treat, 2),
           mean_ctrl  = round(mean_ctrl,  2),
           across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("mean_|log2"), ~round(., 1))) |>
    select(UniRef90_ID, Gene_Name, mean_treat, mean_ctrl, log2FC, enriched_in, everything())

  names(df_g_top)[3] <- sprintf("mean_%s", p$treatment)
  names(df_g_top)[4] <- sprintf("mean_%s", p$control)

  if (nrow(df_g_top) > 0 && max(df_g_top[[3]], na.rm=TRUE) > 0) {
    df_g_top |>
      DT::datatable(
        caption=sprintf(
          "Top 50 microbial gene families (UniRef90 RPK) — %s. mean_COND: mean RPK for that condition. log2FC = log2(treatment/control). enriched_in: |log2FC|>1 threshold.", comp_label),
        filter="top",
        options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE), rownames=FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No gene families detected above threshold.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("HUMAnN3 gene family data not available.\n")
}
```

# TE Somatic Insertions (M23)

> Soft-clipped sequences from STAR chimeric alignments were mapped to DFAM 3.9 TE consensus sequences using BWA-MEM. Clusters of TE-mapping clips at the same genomic locus represent candidate TE insertion sites. Somatic candidates = sites detected in the treatment condition (`r params$treatment`) but not in the control (`r params$control`). **Note:** m23 runs on all samples globally; the somatic_candidate flag uses all-sample comparison, not just this pair.


## Insertion Summary

```{r te-insertion-summary}
if (!is.null(te_ins_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(te_ins_summary,
    col.names=c("Metric","Count"),
    caption="TE insertion detection summary (M23).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)
} else cat("TE insertion summary not available.
")
```

## Insertion Clusters
```{r te-insertion-table, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(te_clusters) && nrow(te_clusters) > 0) {
  if (te_clusters_n7sl_excluded > 0)
    cat(sprintf(
      paste0("> **Note:** %d clusters matching 7SLRNA (Signal Recognition Particle RNA — ",
             "misclassified as SINE/Alu by RepeatMasker but not a transposable element) ",
             "and mitochondrial chromosome (chrM) loci were excluded from all M23 figures ",
             "and tables. These represent mapping artefacts, not genuine somatic TE insertions. ",
             "Retained: %d clusters on canonical chromosomes (chr1–22, X, Y).\n"),
      te_clusters_n7sl_excluded, nrow(te_clusters)))
  # Convert Python bool strings to R logical
  if ("somatic_candidate" %in% colnames(te_clusters) &&
      is.character(te_clusters$somatic_candidate))
    te_clusters$somatic_candidate <- te_clusters$somatic_candidate == "True"
  te_clusters |>
    arrange(desc(n_reads_total)) |>
    head(50) |>
    mutate(somatic = ifelse(somatic_candidate, "yes", "no")) |>
    select(any_of(c("chrom","start","end","te_family","te_macro",
                    "n_reads_total","n_normal","n_tumor","n_control","n_treatment",
                    "somatic","gene_name","dist"))) |>
    DT::datatable(
      caption=sprintf("TE insertion clusters (%d total, 7SLRNA/chrM excluded).",
                      nrow(te_clusters)),
      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE,
                   dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
      extensions="Buttons", rownames=FALSE, filter="top") |>
    print()
} else cat("TE insertion cluster data not available.\n")
```

> **Why do cluster counts differ between conditions?** M23 counts soft-clipped reads mapping to TE consensus sequences (DFAM 3.9) at each genomic locus. Differences between conditions reflect: (1) genuine somatic TE insertions present only in one state (mitosis vs interphase); (2) differences in chromatin accessibility affecting soft-clip production — compacted mitotic chromatin may generate more artifactual clips at certain loci; (3) read depth variation between samples. Somatic candidates (`treatment-only`) require ≥1 supporting read in treatment and 0 in control. Interpret with caution: with n=3 replicates, individual-level variation can generate spurious condition-specific clusters.

```{r te-somatic-plot, fig.height=7, fig.width=12, fig.cap="TE insertion clusters by macrocategory and condition origin. 'Shared' = detected in both conditions; '[treatment]-only' = somatic candidate (present in treatment, absent in control); '[control]-only' = candidate absent in treatment. Left: cluster count per macrocategory; right: total supporting reads. Numbers above bars = cluster count."}
if (!is.null(te_clusters) && nrow(te_clusters) > 0) {
  # Determine per-condition count columns (support both n_normal/n_tumor and n_control/n_treatment)
  nc_col <- if ("n_control"   %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_control"   else
            if ("n_normal"    %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_normal"    else NULL
  nt_col <- if ("n_treatment" %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_treatment" else
            if ("n_tumor"     %in% colnames(te_clusters)) "n_tumor"     else NULL

  if (!is.null(nc_col) && !is.null(nt_col)) {
    lbl_ctrl     <- p$control
    lbl_treat    <- p$treatment
    lbl_shared   <- paste0("Shared (", lbl_ctrl, " + ", lbl_treat, ")")
    lbl_treat_only <- paste0(lbl_treat, "-only")
    lbl_ctrl_only  <- paste0(lbl_ctrl, "-only")

    te_plot <- te_clusters |>
      filter(!is.na(te_macro)) |>
      mutate(
        nc = .data[[nc_col]],
        nt = .data[[nt_col]],
        origin = case_when(
          nc > 0 & nt > 0 ~ lbl_shared,
          nt > 0 & nc == 0 ~ lbl_treat_only,
          nc > 0 & nt == 0 ~ lbl_ctrl_only,
          TRUE             ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        origin = factor(origin, levels=c(lbl_treat_only, lbl_shared, lbl_ctrl_only))
      )

    col_vals <- setNames(
      c("#E74C3C", "#85C1E9", "#F0B27A"),
      c(lbl_treat_only, lbl_shared, lbl_ctrl_only))

    p1 <- te_plot |>
      count(te_macro, origin) |>
      ggplot(aes(x=te_macro, y=n, fill=origin)) +
      geom_col(position="dodge") +
      geom_text(aes(label=n), position=position_dodge(0.9),
                vjust=-0.3, size=3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_vals, name="Origin") +
      labs(title="Cluster count by macrocategory and origin",
           x=NULL, y="Number of clusters") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))

    # Frequency plot: total reads per category × macrocategory
    p2 <- te_plot |>
      group_by(te_macro, origin) |>
      summarise(total_reads=sum(n_reads_total, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
      ggplot(aes(x=te_macro, y=total_reads, fill=origin)) +
      geom_col(position="dodge") +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_vals, name="Origin") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
      labs(title="Supporting reads by macrocategory and origin",
           x=NULL, y="Total supporting reads") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))

    gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)
    # Save summary for table chunk
    .te_origin_summary <- te_plot |>
      group_by(origin) |>
      summarise(n_clusters=n(), total_reads=sum(n_reads_total, na.rm=TRUE),
                pct_clusters=round(100*n()/nrow(te_plot),1), .groups="drop") |>
      arrange(desc(n_clusters))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("Per-condition columns (n_control/n_treatment) not found in cluster table.\n"))
    cat(sprintf("Available columns: %s\n", paste(colnames(te_clusters), collapse=", ")))
    .te_origin_summary <- NULL
  }
} else {
  cat("TE cluster data not available.\n")
  .te_origin_summary <- NULL
}

# Methods

## Reference Data

| Resource | Version/Date | Description |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| GRCh38 | GENCODE v49 | Primary assembly, no patches |
| Gene annotation | GENCODE v49 GTF | 78,691 loci |
| TE consensus | DFAM 3.9 | 26,292 curated TE families |
| Genomic TE coordinates | UCSC RepeatMasker hg38 (Oct 2022) | 4,519,330 entries |

## Read Processing

Reads trimmed with fastp 0.22.0 (auto adapter detection, Q20, min length 36bp). Genome alignment: STAR 2.7.10b two-pass mode with GENCODE v49 splice site annotation (`--twopassMode Basic`, `--outReadsUnmapped Fastx`). Strandedness inferred per-sample with RSeQC infer_experiment.py; library strandedness set in config (`sequencing.strandedness`). Gene counts: featureCounts (subread 2.0.6), `-t exon -g gene_id -s 2 --fracOverlap 0.1 -p --countReadPairs` (strandedness flag set from config value, not from RSeQC per-sample detection — config takes precedence for all quantification). circRNA detection: STAR chimeric alignments (`--chimOutType SeparateSAMold`, `--chimSegmentMin 20`) → CIRI2 v2.0.6. Unmapped reads classified taxonomically with Kraken2 + Bracken v2.1.3 (paired-end mode, species-level re-estimation). RNA editing: JACUSA2 v2.1.16 call-2 (`-filterNH 1`). TE somatic insertions: soft-clipped sequences from STAR chimeric SAM aligned to DFAM 3.9 TE consensus with BWA-MEM 0.7.18.

## TE Quantification — Pseudochromosome Approach

DFAM 3.9 human-clade TE families concatenated into pseudochromosomes (200N spacers between families). Trimmed R1 and R2 reads mapped independently (Bowtie2 `--very-sensitive-local`, default score-min). Fragment counts deduplicated by read name to avoid double-counting. Satellites: separate pseudochromosome with analogous approach. Locus-level: TEtranscripts 2.2.3 (EM multi-mapping, RepeatMasker hg38 GTF) + custom pysam locus counter.

## Differential Expression

DESeq2 1.50.2. Size factors from stable genes (CV<0.3, baseMean>10; fallback: baseMean>10 when <500 stable genes found). LFC shrinkage: ashr. TE/satellite: `independentFiltering=FALSE`. circRNA (n<3 per group): Wilcoxon rank-sum, BH correction.

## GO / Pathway Enrichment

clusterProfiler: `enrichGO` (BP/MF/CC), `enrichKEGG` (KEGG REST API, hsa), `enrichDO` (DOSE, Disease Ontology). ENSEMBL → ENTREZ mapping via `bitr` (org.Hs.eg.db). Universe: expressed genes (baseMean>0) for canonical genes; 51,934 RepeatMasker-intersected genes for TE host analysis. Gene set size: 10–500.
